---
title: "RETAILIRNSA Decomposition"
author: "Roland"
date: "2026-10-11"
output: html_document

---

```{r}
library(fpp2)

RETAILIRNSA <- read.csv("RETAILIRNSA.csv")
retail <- ts(RETAILIRNSA$RETAILIRNSA, start = c(1992, 1), frequency = 12)

head(retail)
plot(retail)
stl_decomp <- stl(retail,s.window ="periodic")
plot(stl_decomp)
attributes(stl_decomp)

# Lets print out a seasonal adjustment
seasadj(stl_decomp)
# Plot a line on the graph
plot(retail)
lines(seasadj(stl_decomp), col="Red")
# Default period forecast
f_stl <- forecast(stl_decomp)
# you can pass the # of period
f_stl <- forecast(stl_decomp,h=15)
f_stl
plot(f_stl)
# There is more than one way to do things
decomp_retail <- decompose(retail)

# Each one shows different attributes 
attributes(decomp_retail)
seasadj(decomp_retail)
```
